cues.text: Defence isn't just another region. It's a different system.
Its own platforms. Its own eligibility gates. And prime flow-down work that never shows up in a regional search.
I review every open solicitation that matches your NAICS codes, your clearance level, and your capability.
cues.say: I review every open solicitation that matches your nakes codes, your clearance level, and your capability.

cues.text: Eligibility is screened before it reaches you. Controlled Goods, clearance, set-asides.
Each one comes with a verdict, and a link to the source solicitation.
Coverage for Canada, or Canada and the United States. On its own, or added to your regional coverage.
Defence volume is low, and the value is high. So I don't promise a count. I promise completeness. Every matching solicitation, reviewed.
Request a defence quote at phildave.com.
